title: Notices and messages: shops and services
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer.
paras: PHARMACY: From this week we are open on Sundays, but only in the morning. On weekdays we now close at 7 pm, not 9 pm.
Hi Lan, sorry, I took your blue umbrella by mistake. Mine is the same colour! I'll leave yours at the reception desk tomorrow morning. Ha
PHONE REPAIRS: Most phones are ready in one hour. Screen repairs take two days. We do not repair tablets.
Shake well before use. Keep away from sunlight. Do not put in the fridge.
BOOK CLUB: This month we are reading The Green River. Copies are on the shelf by the door. Take one and bring it back at our next meeting.
Mia, Dad says you can use the car tonight, but you must put petrol in it before you bring it back. The keys are on the kitchen table. Mum

items.q: What time does the pharmacy close on weekdays now?

ev.s: On weekdays we now close at 7 pm, not 9 pm.

items.why: Ngày thường giờ đóng cửa là 7 giờ tối.

wrong.A: 9 giờ là giờ cũ.
wrong.C: Không ai nhắc 8 giờ.

items.q: Where will Lan's umbrella be tomorrow morning?

ev.s: I'll leave yours at the reception desk tomorrow morning.

items.why: Hà sẽ để ô của Lan ở quầy lễ tân.

wrong.A: Hà không mang đến nhà Lan.
wrong.B: Hà đang giữ ô, nhưng sáng mai sẽ để ở quầy.

items.q: How long does a screen repair take?

ev.s: Screen repairs take two days.

items.why: Sửa màn hình mất hai ngày.

wrong.B: Không ai nhắc một ngày.
wrong.C: Một giờ là cho phần lớn điện thoại.

items.q: Where should you keep it?

ev.s: Keep away from sunlight.

items.why: Tránh ánh nắng.

wrong.B: Nhãn ghi không để tủ lạnh.
wrong.C: Gần cửa sổ là có nắng.

items.q: Where can members find the book?

opts.t: on the shelf by the door

ev.s: Copies are on the shelf by the door.

items.why: Sách để trên kệ cạnh cửa.

wrong.A: Buổi sau là lúc mang trả.
wrong.B: Không cần mua ở hiệu sách.

items.q: What must Mia do before she brings the car back?

ev.s: you must put petrol in it before you bring it back

items.why: Phải đổ xăng trước khi mang xe về.

wrong.A: Chìa khoá ở trên bàn bếp.
wrong.C: Mẹ không nhắc rửa xe.

title: Notices and messages: travel
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer.
paras: TAXIS: Taxis from this rank go to the airport only. For the city centre, please use the taxi rank outside Gate 3.
Hi Duc, the boat trip is cancelled because of the wind. They offered our money back, but I've changed our tickets to tomorrow, same time. Linh
HOTEL POOL: For hotel guests only. Towels are at reception, not by the pool. Children may swim from 9 to 12 only.
Dear passengers, today the 10.15 bus to Hue will leave from stop 6. The 11.15 bus will leave from stop 2 as usual.
BIKE HIRE: 5 dollars for one hour, 12 dollars for the whole day. Helmets are free. Please show your passport or ID card.
Hi Mum, my flight is three hours late, so I'll land at 9, not 6. Don't come to the airport. Uncle Tam will meet me. Huy

items.q: Where do taxis from this rank go?

ev.s: Taxis from this rank go to the airport only.

items.why: Taxi ở đây chỉ đi sân bay.

wrong.A: Đi trung tâm phải ra điểm ngoài Cổng 3.
wrong.B: Cổng 3 là chỗ có điểm đón khác.

items.q: When will Linh and Duc go on the boat trip?

ev.s: I've changed our tickets to tomorrow, same time

items.why: Linh đổi vé sang ngày mai.

wrong.B: Không ai nhắc tuần sau.
wrong.C: Hôm nay bị huỷ vì gió.

items.q: Where can guests get towels?

ev.s: Towels are at reception, not by the pool.

items.why: Khăn ở quầy lễ tân.

wrong.A: Biển ghi không ở cạnh bể.
wrong.C: Biển không nhắc phòng.

items.q: Where will the 10.15 bus leave from today?

ev.s: today the 10.15 bus to Hue will leave from stop 6

items.why: Hôm nay chuyến 10.15 đi từ điểm 6.

wrong.A: Điểm 2 là của chuyến 11.15.
wrong.C: Không ai nhắc điểm 5.

items.q: How much is a bike for the whole day?

ev.s: 12 dollars for the whole day

items.why: Thuê cả ngày 12 đô.

wrong.A: Không ai nhắc 10 đô.
wrong.B: 5 đô là một giờ.

items.q: What time will Huy's plane land?

ev.s: I'll land at 9, not 6

items.why: Máy bay hạ cánh lúc 9 giờ.

wrong.B: 6 giờ là giờ dự kiến cũ.
wrong.C: Ba là số giờ trễ, không phải giờ hạ cánh.

title: Notices and messages: school
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer.
paras: SCHOOL CANTEEN: From Monday, students must bring their own cup for drinks. We will not give out plastic cups.
Hi Thanh, Mr Hung isn't ill, but he has a meeting, so our maths test is now on Friday. We still have the maths lesson today. An
LOST PROPERTY: Things left in classrooms are kept in the office for one week. After that, we give them to charity.
SCHOOL CONCERT: Free for students. Parents pay 3 dollars. Parents, please sit in the back rows.
Ms Lan, my son Bao has a bad cough. He can come to school today, but please don't let him do sport. Thank you. Mrs Huong
ART ROOM: Please wash the brushes before you leave. Don't wash them in the toilets. Use the sink by the window.

items.q: What must students bring from Monday?

ev.s: students must bring their own cup for drinks

items.why: Học sinh mang cốc riêng.

wrong.A: Phải mang cốc, không phải đồ uống.
wrong.B: Biển không nhắc bữa trưa.

items.q: When is the maths test now?

ev.s: our maths test is now on Friday

items.why: Bài kiểm tra chuyển sang thứ Sáu.

wrong.A: Không ai nhắc thứ Năm.
wrong.C: Hôm nay vẫn có tiết toán, không phải bài kiểm tra.

items.q: How long does the office keep lost things?

ev.s: kept in the office for one week

items.why: Văn phòng giữ một tuần.

wrong.B: Không ai nhắc một ngày.
wrong.C: Không ai nhắc một tháng.

items.q: How much do parents pay for the concert?

ev.s: Parents pay 3 dollars.

items.why: Phụ huynh trả 3 đô.

wrong.A: Không ai nhắc 5 đô.
wrong.C: Miễn phí là học sinh.

items.q: What must Bao not do today?

ev.s: please don't let him do sport

items.why: Mẹ xin cho Bảo không tập thể thao.

wrong.B: Bảo vẫn đi học được.
wrong.C: Mẹ không nhắc giờ ra chơi.

items.q: Where should students wash the brushes?

opts.t: at the sink by the door
at the sink by the window

ev.s: Use the sink by the window.

items.why: Rửa ở bồn cạnh cửa sổ.

wrong.A: Biển cấm rửa trong nhà vệ sinh.
wrong.B: Bồn ở cạnh cửa sổ, không phải cạnh cửa ra vào.

title: Notices and messages: home and neighbours
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer.
paras: TO ALL NEIGHBOURS: There will be no water on Tuesday from 8 am to 2 pm. Please keep some water on Monday night. Building manager
Hi Tuan, your parcel came while you were out. I didn't want to leave it outside your door, so it's at my flat, number 12. Come any time after 6. Mrs Oanh
FOR SALE: Sofa, two years old, 50 dollars. You must collect it yourself. Free table if you buy before Sunday.
Hi Kim, can you water my plants while I'm away? Only the ones on the balcony. The ones inside don't need any water. Thanks! Vy
CAR PARK: Residents only after 6 pm. Visitors may park here during the day.
Grandma, I've taken the dog for a walk. I'll be back in an hour. I've already fed him, so please don't give him dinner. Linh

items.q: When will there be no water?

ev.s: There will be no water on Tuesday from 8 am to 2 pm.

items.why: Mất nước thứ Ba từ 8 giờ sáng đến 2 giờ chiều.

wrong.A: Từ 2 giờ chiều thứ Ba đã có nước lại.
wrong.C: Tối thứ Hai là lúc tích nước.

items.q: Which flat is the parcel in now?

ev.s: it's at my flat, number 12

items.why: Gói hàng ở căn hộ số 12.

wrong.A: Không ai nhắc số 2.
wrong.B: 6 giờ là giờ Tuấn đến lấy được.

items.q: What do you get if you buy the sofa before Sunday?

ev.s: Free table if you buy before Sunday.

items.why: Mua trước Chủ nhật được tặng bàn.

wrong.A: Không ai nhắc ghế.
wrong.B: Không ai nhắc đèn.

items.q: Which plants should Kim water?

ev.s: Only the ones on the balcony.

items.why: Chỉ tưới cây ngoài ban công.

wrong.A: Cây trong nhà không cần nước.
wrong.C: Vy không nhắc vườn.

items.q: When can visitors park here?

ev.s: Visitors may park here during the day.

items.why: Khách được đỗ ban ngày.

wrong.B: Sau 6 giờ tối chỉ cư dân.
wrong.C: Biển không nói chỉ cuối tuần.

items.q: What should Grandma not do?

opts.t: take the dog for a walk

ev.s: please don't give him dinner

items.why: Linh dặn đừng cho chó ăn tối.

wrong.B: Linh đã dắt chó đi rồi.
wrong.C: Linh không dặn bà đừng đợi.

title: Notices and messages: free time
instr: For each question, choose the correct answer.
paras: CINEMA: Tuesday is half-price day. This offer is not for 3D films.
Hi Ben, the concert starts at 8, but the doors open at 7. Let's meet by the doors at 7 to get good seats. Ana
SWIMMING IN THE LAKE: Only at weekends, from 10 am to 5 pm. There is nobody to help you on weekdays.
Hi Phuong, I've got two tickets for the football on Saturday, but my brother can't come. Do you want his ticket? It's free! Nam
GAME SHOP: Bring your old games and get money for new ones. We don't buy games without their boxes.
Hi Tom, the restaurant is full on Friday, so I've booked a table for Saturday. It's at 7, the same time as we planned. Mai

items.q: Which day is half price?

ev.s: Tuesday is half-price day.

items.why: Thứ Ba giảm nửa giá.

wrong.A: Không ai nhắc thứ Hai.
wrong.C: Không ai nhắc thứ Năm.

items.q: When do the doors open?

ev.s: the doors open at 7

items.why: Cửa mở lúc 7 giờ.

wrong.B: 8 giờ là giờ hoà nhạc bắt đầu.
wrong.C: Không ai nhắc 6.30.

items.q: When can people swim in the lake?

ev.s: Only at weekends, from 10 am to 5 pm.

items.why: Chỉ bơi cuối tuần.

wrong.A: Chỉ cuối tuần.
wrong.C: Ngày thường không có ai giúp nên không được bơi.

items.q: Whose ticket does Nam want to give Phuong?

ev.s: Do you want his ticket?

items.why: Nam tặng vé của em trai.

wrong.A: Nam vẫn đi xem.
wrong.B: Không ai nhắc bố.

items.q: Which games won't the shop buy?

ev.s: We don't buy games without their boxes.

items.why: Không mua game không có hộp.

wrong.A: Cửa hàng mua game cũ, không nhắc game mới.
wrong.B: Biển không nhắc game trẻ em.

items.q: When will Mai and Tom go to the restaurant?

ev.s: I've booked a table for Saturday

items.why: Mai đặt bàn thứ Bảy.

wrong.B: Thứ Sáu nhà hàng kín chỗ.
wrong.C: Không ai nhắc Chủ nhật.
